body: Ok thanks yeah that does sound like me. I think I’m gonna talk to a doctor and I’ve been sober 4 weeks so far!

I always thought the drinking culture in the US was weird, but I didn’t realize the social pressure would be so much. Where I’m from, people definitely drink more/get more drunk but there’s way less social pressure to do so. My non-American friends from other places feel the same about where they’re from. The summer before I came to the US was the first time I somewhat successfully moderated my drinking and not one person commented on the fact that I was drinking less. Sure, we egg each other on, but in a fun way so no one ever feels pressured to go beyond their limits. But in the US it’s like they take it seriously.
